test_evidence_policy: All behavioral commands/exits are inherited from hash-verified R12 evidence. This bounded packaging task did not rerun broad suites; fresh reviews own independent commands.

r12_red_claim_audit.reason: The retained transcript hash matches, but its only procedure header is `$ git worktree HEAD + focused P10-R12 regression tests`; it does not pin an immutable pre-repair commit/tree, copied-test byte hashes, temporary worktree/archive identity, or exact executable commands. The claimed pre-repair failures therefore cannot be reproduced as an exact procedure and are removed rather than presented as RED evidence.

green.note: Retained R12 GREEN logs are hash-verified historical evidence and are not self-review or integration approval.

known_limits: No independent public external-WAN/provider-egress vantage or privileged deployment evidence was available; external reachability remains local/sandbox evidence only.
Provider pending/busy/rate_limited responses remain non-terminal and rely on manager recovery retry; timeout/transport taxonomy remains the terminal boundary.
Restart recovery intentionally bounds in-memory active/replay maps; durable rows outside the in-memory cap remain fail-closed until expiry/cleanup.

One initial concurrent make test run recorded an E2E deletion failure; the retained standalone E2E and final qualified make test evidence passed, but fresh reviewers must independently rerun their commands.
This packaging task did not rerun broad suites and does not approve implementation, integration, real-WAN support, native Windows/arm64 execution, router traversal, deployment, or soak capability.
residual_risk: Provider pending/busy/rate_limited responses remain non-terminal and rely on manager recovery retry; timeout/transport taxonomy remains the terminal boundary.
Restart recovery intentionally bounds in-memory active/replay maps; durable rows outside the in-memory cap are fail-closed until expiry/cleanup.
The R12 RED claim is unavailable as exact reproducible RED evidence and is explicitly removed; reviewers can rely only on retained GREEN evidence plus fresh independent testing.
The handoff-only tip is audit metadata after the immutable implementation candidate and must not be treated as candidate code.
cleanup: The 21 pre-existing source/test byte sequences were hash-verified and committed unchanged as the implementation candidate.
No production/test byte was edited by this packaging task; no frozen contract, integration branch, remote, credential, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, push, tag, or release was touched.
Only the canonical and R11 handoff JSON files are permitted in the later documentation-only commit.
Final clean-worktree verification and the documentation-only tip SHA/tree are reported in the review-required Kanban block because a commit cannot self-record its own SHA.
required_reviews: fresh exact-head P10 full quality/security review
integration only after every required fresh review passes against the immutable implementation commit/tree
